checks: Only the authenticated order seller can create a label or declare carrier handoff.
Commerce authorizes shipment creation from locked payment and financial state.
The buyer can read tracking but never receives a label URL or label token.
Label downloads use short-lived seller-bound capabilities.
Carrier observations reach Commerce only through the system reconciliation function.
Mondial Relay arrival and pickup availability never become recipient handoff.
The Commerce public order id is the one-shipment idempotency key.
resources: Seller shipment, label capability, handoff, cancellation, and reconciliation commands
